title: Barefoot Young Boys Holding Flowers in Sunny Garden, 1940s Snapshot Photo
description: Two barefoot young boys, likely brothers, stand in a sunlit grassy backyard holding large bouquets of white garden flowers. Both are dressed in casual striped summer rompers or bib shorts without shirts, smiling gently toward the camera. In the background, lush shrubs and the clapboard siding of a residential home are visible under bright midday sunlight.
